evidence: Stored title, abstract and query intent. No full-paper review or external verification.
protocol: Single AI assessor. Read shuffled candidates without inspecting manifest ranks or ranker assignments. Grade 0 irrelevant, 1 partial/background, 2 directly relevant. One rationale per query-paper pair.
limitations: Provisional AI judgments, not human ground truth. No independent assessor or agreement estimate. Assessor previously implemented this benchmark and is not an independent validator.
